sentence: This project studies how retinoic acid controls the formation of glial cells during development of the nervous system in the African Clawed Frog.
This project studies how the waxy substance on red harvester ants relates to water loss and to how colonies handle foraging in dry conditions.
This project builds a wireless system that uses programmable antenna panels to send radio signals over long distances on farms.
This project develops technologies that make energy more reliable and efficient for energy-intensive industries such as chemicals and steel.
This project designs algorithms that group data points into clusters, including clusters of strings and hierarchical clusters.
This project moves an open-source software to a stronger form of encryption that protects its users against quantum computing.
This project studies how fungi, plants, and animals tolerate desiccation and how they respond when they are rehydrated.
This project studies how teachers plan lessons that use mechatronics and how they use technological tools in those lessons.
This project tests how saltwater changes water chemistry, microbial communities, and methane emissions in wetland ponds.
This project builds synthetic microbiomes for brine shrimp to help them use feed efficiently and prevent infection by a bacterial pathogen.
This project studies how to react to cyberattacks on power distribution systems that are meant to cause a voltage collapse.
This project studies how transposable elements copy themselves in corn and how their numbers and locations affect the corn plant.
This project studies how population density changes locust behavior, so that solitary grasshoppers become swarming pests.
This project studies water resources needed for food and energy production and for healthy ecosystems.
This project builds a computer-aided approach that generates chemical process designs using artificial intelligence and quantum computing.
This project tests whether space-made nanoparticles that deliver drugs to solid tumors are comparable with versions made on Earth.
This project installs a confocal microscope imaging system to look at cells, tissues, and organisms.
